name: peek_session
description: Read a snapshot of another agent's chat session. For "what is that agent doing" use mode=brief or structured. mode=handoff does not spawn anything: the result's `material` string is a complete prompt (writing instructions and the eight section headings, heuristic hints, then the compressed transcript between `--- transcript ---` and `--- end transcript ---`); you are the harness, so answer that prompt yourself and the markdown you produce is the handoff. `document` in that result is only a regex stub.

selector.description: Session displayName, id, tag, or cwd.

mode.description: raw: transcript messages (windowed). structured: stable fields (currentTask, activity, writingFiles, pending tools). brief: one-paragraph status; use this for "what is that agent doing". summary: prose. handoff: `material` for you to write a handoff document from.

target.description: handoff mode: who the handoff is for (generic, claude-code, codex, gemini, copilot, opencode, chatgpt, claude-chat). Chat targets get code inlined; CLI targets get paths.

since.description: Cursor returned by a prior peek.

first.description: Show the first N raw messages.

last.description: Show the last N raw messages.

around.description: Show raw messages around this 1-based message number.

offset.description: Skip N messages from the selected raw edge.

includeEnded.description: Include ended sessions when status is not provided.

includeTerminal.description: Include terminal capture adapters such as tmux and screen.

name: coordination_digest
description: Summarize nearby agent activity, changes since a prior digest, and possible overlap.

cwd.description: Working directory to summarize. Omit to include all active sessions.

writingOnly.description: Only include sessions with recent write intent.

since.description: Coordination cursor returned by a prior digest.

includeTerminal.description: Include terminal capture adapters such as tmux and screen.

name: tag_session
description: Give a session a friendly tag for easier addressing.

name: post_to_feed
description: Publish a token-budgeted context post (finding, intent, warning, question, answer, handoff, status) to this project's feed so other agents can ingest it instead of re-exploring.

text.description: Max ~150 tokens; link evidence instead of inlining

dir.description: Project directory; defaults to server cwd

name: read_feed
description: Read this project's context feed: posts from other agents ranked by relevance to your working set and packed to a token budget. Call before exploring the repo.

context_paths.description: Paths you are working on (improves ranking)

include_derived.description: Include derived status/overlap posts, default true

name: expand_post
description: Fetch one feed post in full, including evidence references, before trusting or acting on it.

name: usage_report
description: Which skills and tools have actually been invoked, across every agent, from peek's durable index. Returns an envelope carrying the observed window, per-adapter windows, and the agents peek cannot see — counts are meaningless without them.

skill.description: Only this skill or command name.

tool.description: Only invocations of this tool. Default: skills only.

sidechain.description: true for subagent calls only, false for main loop only.

attributionAgent.description: Subagent type that made the call.

includeBuiltins.description: Keep CLI built-ins like /clear, which are recorded but are not skills.

name: skills_report
description: Skill inventory segmented by what can honestly be acted on: archivable, unknown usage, read-only, in use. Summary first with per-segment totals, then a capped slice. Needs the usage index; without it, segments are withheld rather than reporting every skill as unused.

segment.description: Return rows for one segment only. Totals for every segment are always included.

name: skill_detail
description: One skill: its installations per agent, what archiving each would do, per-agent usage coverage, and cost. Returns paths and flags, never SKILL.md content.

skill.description: Skill name or key, as returned by skills_report.

name: archive_plan
description: What archiving a skill WOULD do, plus the command a human runs to do it. Changes nothing: peek exposes no tool that can archive, because dry-run-by-default works by a person reading the plan.

name: list_agents
description: Coding agents peek knows: which are on this machine, whether each entry is verified or sourced from a third-party table, and what peek can observe and attribute for each.

all.description: Include agents peek knows of that are not installed here.
